conventions.verified_rule: true if >=1 observation cites a source with source_type in [extension, usda]
conventions.observation_model: Each claim field holds an observations[] array; each observation keeps its own verbatim text + source_id. conflict=true when observations materially disagree.
conventions.descriptive_vocab_note: Establishment speed (slow/medium/fast), growth habit, mowing frequency, fertility requirement, and thatch tendency are stored verbatim as 'value' and NOT forced onto the poor-excellent rating scale.
conventions.calculator_recommended_value_note: Selected fields carry a calculator_recommended_value: the single value/range the calculator should use, while ALL verbatim observations are retained untouched. Rules: (1) seeding_rate_new for every species. (2) Regional tolerance conflicts use regional_range:true and keep BOTH endpoints (no winner picked) for region-aware answers. (3) seeds_per_pound and white_clover drought anchors use the majority (or, on a tie, more-recent) source; the minority value stays recorded as an observation. (4) verified:false on an anchor (microclover record; white_clover LAWN rate) means vendor-only or absent — NOT calculator-trusted.

'high'/'low' map to the tolerance scale ONLY for tolerance fields; for requirement/frequency/thatch fields they are stored verbatim, not mapped. Phrases NOT in this table are left rating_status=ambiguous_flagged for audit (see audit_queue).

Do NOT present as extension-verified; obtain an extension microclover source before calculator trust. Vendor shade rating (Poor) conflicts with extension white_clover (Good).

data_quality_flags.issue: No extension or USDA source provides a white-clover LAWN seeding rate in lb/1000ft2. All extension/USDA white-clover sources give only lb/acre (pasture overseed 2-4; cover-crop solid 4-8; beautification 2), and the three dedicated turf-establishment extension sheets (Penn State Lawn Establishment, Rutgers FS584, UMass Seeding Rate Considerations) do NOT list clover among lawn species.
data_quality_flags.resolution: Lawn rate is available ONLY from vendor sources, carried in the 'microclover' record (verified:false): ~1-2 lb/1000ft2 pure stand, ~5% by weight in a grass mix. Calculator must treat white-clover/microclover lawn rate as UNVERIFIED until an extension clover-lawn source is located.

species.extraction_notes: VENDOR-ONLY record (verified:false). Captures the microclover lawn seeding rate in lb/1000ft2 that extension sources lacked: ~1-2 lb/1000ft2 pure stand (Outside Pride), ~0.88-1.1 lb/1000ft2 raw/pelleted (West Coast Seeds), or ~5% by weight in a grass mix. Distinct from extension-verified white_clover (larger common/Ladino Trifolium repens); microclover is a dwarf selection. Tolerances are vendor icon ratings; shade rating conflicts with extension white_clover. Needs an extension microclover source before calculator trust.
